name: True Love Waits
overview: True love waits because the heart, though deceitful and wicked (Jeremiah 17:9), is the wellspring of life and must be guarded diligently (Proverbs 4:23). God’s love, demonstrated supremely in the giving of His Son (John 3:16), calls believers to seek Him earnestly (Matthew 7:8) and to live by the power of the gospel (Romans 1:16). This includes turning away from the works of the flesh such as fornication and uncleanness (Galatians 5:19), embracing purity as an expression of faith and obedience to Christ.
